summary: Iteration 19 - Complete testing of Admin Panel expansion features. Fixed MongoDB _id bug in admin_actions collection. All 23 backend API tests passed. All 15 frontend features verified.
seed_data_creation: Test user blocked/unblocked during testing, test demand cancelled during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin panel fully tested. Key features: 1) Block/unblock users with email notification, 2) Edit user profiles, 3) Send custom messages to users, 4) Cancel demands with reason, 5) Notify demand owners (wrong_category, improve_description, vulgar_language, custom), 6) Approve/reject category suggestions. All actions send appropriate emails. Badge on Kategorie tab shows pending suggestions count.

BACKEND_PUT_BLOCK_USER.details: PUT /api/admin/users/{id}/block - blocks user and sends email notification

BACKEND_BLOCKED_USER_LOGIN_403.details: Blocked user receives 403 on login attempt with message about being blocked

BACKEND_POST_MESSAGE_USER.details: POST /api/admin/users/{id}/message - sends custom email to user

BACKEND_PUT_CANCEL_DEMAND.details: PUT /api/admin/demands/{id}/cancel - cancels demand with reason, sends email to customer

FRONTEND_ADMIN_4_TABS.details: Admin panel has 4 tabs: Přehled, Uživatelé, Zakázky, Kategorie with badge on Kategorie showing pending count

FRONTEND_USERS_TAB_ACTIONS.details: Users tab shows action buttons (edit, message, block/unblock) and search works

FRONTEND_BLOCK_USER_MODAL.details: Block user modal appears with confirmation, after confirming user shows as 'Blokován'

FRONTEND_DEMANDS_TAB_DROPDOWN.details: Demands tab has dropdown menu with 5 options: Špatná kategorie, Vylepšit popis, Nevhodná slova, Vlastní oznámení, Zrušit zakázku

FRONTEND_VULGAR_LANGUAGE_MODAL.details: Vulgar language notification modal shows flagged_words input field

FRONTEND_CATEGORIES_TAB.details: Categories tab shows pending suggestions with Schválit/Zamítnout buttons and history section

bug_fixed.root_cause: Code was setting _id: None which caused duplicate key errors on subsequent inserts
bug_fixed.fix: Removed _id: None and added uuid.uuid4() for unique id field
